local: The key goes only to the app that opened this page: it collects the key from this server itself, with a one-time secret that only the app knows.

waiting.title: {client} is picking up its key
waiting.body: The app collects the key from {appName} by itself. Keep it open; this usually takes a few seconds.
waiting.close: You can close this window once the app says it is signed in.

fallback.summary: App still not signed in after a minute?
fallback.body: Copy this key and paste it into the app's sign-in window instead.
